- Upstream: https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode
- License: **Apache-2.0**, included as `html5-qrcode.LICENSE`.
- Retrieved using HTTPS with certificate verification on 2026-11-12.
- SHA-256: `660b12437b1d747e3e68b8be0685c08cb728140110ad213f167b14b66f8b1d8e`.
